sdc.daemon.SerialKey.title: SerialKey
sdc.daemon.SerialKey.description: Optional text, 1 to 200 characters, that the submitter names (the daemon never derives one): runs with one key run one at a time, in the order they were submitted. A run whose key a live run submitted before it holds is WaitingOnKey until no such run is live; runs with another key or none are not held. A key that is empty or longer is refused before anything is written (400).
